title: Crystal structure of the basic erbium tetramethyl-heptanedionate, Er8O(thd)10(OH)12

synthesis.procedure: Isolated only as a minor by-product when Er(thd)3, itself prepared by the method of Eisentraut and Sievers (1968), was recrystallized from n-hexane. Three crystal habits formed; the title compound was the third habit and sublimes with anhydrous Er(thd)3. No reagent quantities, temperature, time, or yield are given in the main text. The deposited supplement contains structure-factor tables, not a preparation.

reagents.name: tris(2,2,6,6-tetramethylheptane-3,5-dionato)erbium(III)
reagents.role: precursor whose recrystallization produced the by-product

synthesis.vessel_or_method: recrystallization from n-hexane of Er(thd)3 prepared by a literature method
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Separated by crystal habit from anhydrous and hydrated Er(thd)3; sublimes together with anhydrous Er(thd)3.
